en: A black‑and‑white studio portrait of a man with short hair, a prominent mustache and small goatee, wearing a dark suit jacket, high-collared shirt and patterned bow tie. The figure fades softly into a light background in a classic cabinet-card or postcard style. At the bottom border, ornate studio-imprint text appears, including a photographer's name and the word "STOCKHOLM."
